title: Sheaf direct-image square mate compatibility with derived units
statement: For the cartesian square p:X×_R B→X, q:X×_R B→Spec B of f:X→Spec R and g:Spec B→Spec R, use the canonical derived pullback comparisons and the pinned pullback/direct-image adjunctions of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] and [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. There is an underived comparison e:p_*;f_* ≅ q_*;g_* acting as the identity on sections of the whole open. For every homotopy-category object J, its localization followed by the pasted units for q_*,g_* equals the pasted units for p_*,f_* followed by the conjugate δ of the canonical pullback square. The full equation is recorded in lean.statement. This statement has no affine sections functor or affine comparison t,b,v,r,z,d,s.

source.place: Tag 08HY, Remark 20.28.3; Tag 0D5T, Lemma 20.28.2, with the normalized derived adjunction and left-derived composition equations

proof.text: Construct the ordinary comparison from pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr along the pullback condition, and inverse pushforwardComp. Apply the proved directImageSquareIso_top to obtain the whole-space section identity.

Apply derivedDirectImage_square_mate to the pullback square. The private canonical_adjoint_eq proves the equality of the two pinned adjunction names by reflexivity. The private canonical_conjugate_eq transports this equality through adjunction composition and conjugateEquiv by congrArg₂, avoiding repeated unfolding of the chosen adjunction data. Evaluate the resulting equality at Qh(J): delta is the first normalized composition comparison, equality transport of the composite derived direct image, and the inverse second comparison.

Obtain the two inverse-comparison unit equations from exists_derivedModuleDirectImageComposition, through the proved normalized_unit helper. Keep J arbitrary. The proved generic square_paste helper rewrites the pasted first unit using its equation, substitutes the square-mate formula, and cancels the adjacent inverse/comparison isomorphisms. Apply directImageSquare_unit_transport, then the second inverse-comparison unit equation. Associativity gives the requested equation. Only isomorphisms are cancelled, never a derived unit.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08HY and 0D5T; normalized square-mate and composition-unit pasting, with explicit congruence of the two pinned adjunction names and ordinary single-unit equality transport left separately.

theorem exists_derivedPushforwardSquareMateUnit
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec R) (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R) :
    let P₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.fst f g).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let Q₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let G₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let RF := schemeDerivedDirectImage f
    let RG := schemeDerivedDirectImage g
    let a := fun {A D : Scheme.{u}} (h : A ⟶ D) ↦ canonicalPullbackAdjunction h
    let p : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (i : Y ⟶ Z),
        derivedPullback i ⋙ derivedPullback h ≅ derivedPullback (h ≫ i) :=
      @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    let k := p (pullback.snd f g) g ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun h ↦ derivedPullback h)
        (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := g)).symm) ≪≫
      (p (pullback.fst f g) f).symm
    let δ := conjugateEquiv ((a f).comp (a (pullback.fst f g)))
      ((a g).comp (a (pullback.snd f g))) k.hom
    ∃ e : P₀ ⋙ F₀ ≅ Q₀ ⋙ G₀,
      (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace))
        (x : M.val.obj (op ⊤)), ((e.hom.app M).val.app (op ⊤)) x = x) ∧
      ∀ J : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ),
        F₀.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((P₀.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
          RF.map (P₀.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app J) ≫
          δ.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J) =
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((e.hom.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).app J) ≫
          G₀.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((Q₀.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
          RG.map (Q₀.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app J)
